S025.name: Loss_of_Interest
S025.description: A state where interest or pleasure in previously enjoyed activities is markedly diminished.

subtypes.Loss of Interest: Reduced interest in previously enjoyed hobbies or leisure activities.
subtypes.Social Withdrawal: Reduced interest or effort in social interactions and maintaining relationships.
subtypes.Loss of Motivation: Lack of motivation to initiate or complete work or tasks.
subtypes.Anhedonia: Inability to experience positive emotions such as happiness, satisfaction, love, or pleasure.
subtypes.Indifference to Achievement: Insensitivity or indifference to personal achievements or success.

S026.name: Weight_Appetite_Change
S026.description: Significant increase or decrease in appetite or weight.

subtypes.Significant Weight Loss: Weight loss of more than 5% in a month without dieting.
subtypes.Weight Gain: Weight gain of more than 5% in a month.
subtypes.Decrease in Appetite: Decrease in appetite occurring nearly every day.
subtypes.Increase in Appetite: Increase in appetite occurring nearly every day.

S027.name: Sleep_Disturbance
S027.description: A state where there is a significant change in the quantity or quality of sleep.

subtypes.Initial Insomnia: Difficulty falling asleep and taking a long time to do so.
subtypes.Middle Insomnia: Waking up frequently during sleep or having difficulty falling back asleep.
subtypes.Early Morning Awakening: Waking up too early and being unable to fall back asleep.
subtypes.Hypersomnia: Sleeping for long periods at night or excessive sleep during the day.
subtypes.Nightmare Disorder: Sleep disturbance caused by repeated and distressing dreams.
subtypes.Non-Restorative Sleep: Feeling unrefreshed despite having slept enough.

S029.name: Fatigue
S029.description: Persistent fatigue that is not relieved by rest and a marked lack of energy.

subtypes.Chronic Fatigue: Fatigue that persists for a long period even after adequate rest.
subtypes.Physical Fatigue: A state of physical exhaustion where the body feels heavy and easily tires even from minor activities.
subtypes.Mental Fatigue: A state where fatigue accumulates rapidly during the process of thinking or concentrating.
subtypes.Loss of Energy: Difficulty performing daily activities due to a decline in energy and vitality.

S030.name: Worthlessness_Guilt
S030.description: Feelings of worthlessness or excessive or inappropriate guilt (which may be delusional; not merely self-reproach or guilt about being sick).

subtypes.Feelings of Worthlessness: The feeling that one is useless and has no value.
subtypes.Ruminative Guilt: A thought pattern of obsessively replaying past minor mistakes or flaws and constantly reproaching oneself.
subtypes.Excessive or Inappropriate Guilt: Feeling excessive responsibility for trivial matters or daily events and believing one deserves punishment.
subtypes.Delusional Guilt: Guilt reaching a delusional level, disconnected from reality, involving feeling responsible for unrelated unfortunate events.

S031.name: Diminished_Thinking
S031.description: Diminished ability to think or concentrate, or indecisiveness.

subtypes.Reduced Concentration: Unable to pay attention or maintain focus on specific activities like conversation, reading, or watching TV.
subtypes.Indecisiveness: Extreme difficulty making even minor daily choices (e.g., menu, clothes) and hesitating to make decisions.
subtypes.Subjective Memory Complaints: Complaining of memory decline, such as forgetting where things were placed, due to reduced focus.
subtypes.Clouded Thinking: Thinking feels foggy, dazed, or not clear.

S032.name: Death_Suicide
S032.description: Recurrent thoughts of death, recurrent suicidal ideation, or a suicide attempt.

subtypes.Recurrent Thoughts of Death: Passive wish to die (e.g., 'I wish I wouldn't wake up') without active intent to kill oneself.
subtypes.Suicidal Ideation: Recurring thoughts of 'I want to die' or 'I want to kill myself' without a specific plan.
subtypes.Suicidal Impulse: Strong, sudden urges to jump from a height or run into traffic without a concrete plan.
subtypes.Specific Plan for Suicide: Conceiving specific scenarios or methods regarding when, where, and how to die.
subtypes.Suicide Attempt: Actual actions taken to end one's life or preparatory behaviors like hoarding pills or writing a will.

info.persona: Marilyn Guzman is a routine‑driven, competitive STEM educator who channels their anxiety into disciplined teaching, meticulous budgeting, and a blend of family‑centered fitness and creative hobbies.
info.professional_persona: Marilyn Guzman, a seasoned secondary‑school STEM teacher, blends meticulous curriculum design, data‑driven assessment, and technology integration with their cautious, competitive nature, steering the classroom toward measurable success while mentoring robotics and coding clubs.
info.cultural_background: Marilyn grew up in a middle‑class, predominantly white suburban neighborhood in Bergen County, New Jersey. Her family values emphasized education, hard work, and community involvement, with a strong sense of tradition and practicality. She was raised in a Protestant household that celebrated holidays with family gatherings and community service. The multicultural fabric of Lodi and surrounding towns exposed her to a variety of cultural perspectives, fostering a respectful but cautious approach to new ideas. Her upbringing reinforced a belief in stable routines, self‑reliance, and the importance of contributing to local schools and civic organizations.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Outside of work, Marilyn enjoys group‑oriented activities that let her stay socially engaged yet structured. She regularly plays on a local co‑ed softball league, participates in a weekend book club focused on mystery and thriller novels, and volunteers to lead after‑school coding workshops. She finds relaxation in gardening her backyard flower beds, cooking family meals (especially baking cookies), and attending community fitness classes like Zumba that combine energy with routine. To manage stress, she practices guided meditation once a week and enjoys weekend hikes in nearby state parks with her husband and children.
info.sports_persona: Marilyn Guzman plays on a local co‑ed softball league, avidly supports the Seattle Mariners and the WNBA’s Seattle Storm, and stays fit through community Zumba sessions, weekend hikes in nearby state parks, and occasional participation in a family‑friendly cycling club.
info.arts_persona: Marilyn Guzman devotes evenings to a mystery‑thriller book club featuring authors like Gillian Flynn and Tana French, enjoys listening to Taylor Swift and the classic scores of Hans Zimmer, and attends the community theater’s productions of works such as Arthur Miller’s *The Crucible*.
info.travel_persona: Marilyn Guzman prefers meticulously planned family trips that balance relaxation with adventure, having recently explored the geysers of Yellowstone National Park, the historic streets of Savannah, Georgia, and dreaming of a spring visit to the cherry blossoms in Kyoto, Japan.
info.culinary_persona: Marilyn Guzman, a confident home cook, delights in baking chocolate chip cookies, crafting garden‑fresh herb pesto pasta, and preparing hearty lasagna with locally sourced vegetables, while occasionally treating the family to sushi rolls from a nearby bistro.

info.persona: Mohamad Olivier epitomizes a methodical, 45‑year‑old construction veteran whose love for routine fuels meticulous project management, garden planning, and precision woodcraft, yet they wrestle with chronic worry, over‑schedule even leisure time, and maintain a secret penchant for early‑morning lake fishing as a solitary escape.
info.professional_persona: Mohamad Olivier, a senior construction project manager with two decades of experience, leverages meticulous scheduling, rigorous safety compliance, and precise risk assessments to deliver large‑scale builds, and they mentor crews with a quietly cooperative style that reflects their routine‑driven, disciplined nature and their ambition to become a director of construction operations.
info.cultural_background: Mohamad is a white Midwesterner whose family roots trace back to several generations of small‑town residents in Michigan and neighboring states. He grew up in a modest, middle‑class household that valued hard work, self‑reliance, and community involvement. His upbringing emphasized practical education, respect for tradition, and modest religious observance, which fostered a pragmatic worldview and a strong sense of responsibility toward family and neighbors. Living in East Lansing, he is familiar with the region’s agricultural heritage, seasonal rhythms, and local customs, and he often participates in neighborhood gatherings and community service events that reinforce communal harmony.
info.hobbies_and_interests: In his limited free time, Mohamad engages in solitary, hands‑on activities that reinforce his preference for routine and tangible outcomes. He enjoys woodworking projects that allow him to apply precise measurements and craftsmanship, tending to his garden where he follows a seasonal planting schedule, and fishing early mornings on nearby lakes, which offers quiet reflection. He also reads non‑fiction books on construction technology, local history, and personal development, participates in a small chess club with a few close friends, and volunteers occasionally at the local high school to teach basic construction safety, reflecting his cooperative nature.
info.sports_persona: Mohamad Olivier, a steadfast Detroit Lions and Michigan Wolverines fan, spends their Saturday mornings jogging the trails of Belle Isle State Park, participates in a local fishing club that meets at Lake St. Clair for early‑morning bass trips, and they maintain a twice‑weekly strength‑training routine at FitForce Fitness to protect their back, embodying a methodical approach to fitness and community involvement.
info.arts_persona: Mohamad Olivier, a solitary craftsperson who enjoys the mellow acoustic melodies of John Coltrane, the timeless storytelling of Bob Dylan, and the evocative black‑and‑white landscapes of Ansel Adams, they occasionally attend intimate productions at the Detroit Repertory Theatre, allowing understated artistic experiences to counterbalance their structured professional life.
info.travel_persona: Mohamad Olivier prefers carefully planned road trips that combine scenic drives through Michigan’s Upper Peninsula with scheduled visits to historic architectural sites, they have already explored Chicago’s Art Institute and a weekend getaway to Asheville’s Biltmore Estate, and they now envision a month‑long sustainable‑design study tour of Iceland’s geothermal projects, balancing their love for routine with occasional cultural adventure.
info.culinary_persona: Mohamad Olivier, an adept home cook, frequently prepares hearty plates such as seared Michigan‑raised steak with rosemary‑garlic butter, pan‑roasted salmon seasoned with wild‑foraged dill, and fresh cherry pie made with locally harvested Michigan cherries—ingredients they often harvest from their garden and the nearby farmer’s market—while they reward themselves with a weekly sushi takeaway from a downtown spot as a small, well‑earned treat.

info.persona: Even Konda, a 50‑year‑old healthcare social worker, balances data‑driven advocacy with spontaneous garden experiments, often wrestling with anxiety‑induced worries while they steadfastly commit to community service.
info.professional_persona: Even Konda, a seasoned healthcare social worker in Harford County, blends analytical rigor from a STEM background with empathetic case management, utilizing data tools like SPSS and telehealth platforms while they navigate community resources with a flexible, sometimes relaxed yet ultimately compassionate and assertive approach.
info.cultural_background: Even was raised in a middle‑class, white family of mixed Irish and German ancestry in the Mid‑Atlantic region. Her upbringing in suburban Maryland emphasized community involvement, respect for public institutions, and a strong work ethic. She maintains ties to regional traditions such as farmer’s markets and church gatherings, and she is attuned to the cultural diversity of Harford County, which informs her inclusive and culturally competent approach to social work.
info.hobbies_and_interests: In her free time Even pursues activities that balance structure with creative flexibility. She tends a small vegetable garden, experiments with seasonal, health‑focused recipes, and practices gentle yoga and mindfulness to manage stress. She enjoys hiking the trails of Harford County, capturing nature photographs, and reading historical mystery novels. Socially, she participates in a local book club and volunteers at a community food pantry, allowing her to stay connected while honoring her need for solitary reflection.
info.sports_persona: Even Konda enjoys low‑impact fitness, favoring gentle yoga sessions and weekend hikes with the Harford County Trailblazers while they cheer on the Baltimore Ravens and the Orioles, and they occasionally join a local adult softball league despite their occasional disorganization with equipment.
info.arts_persona: Even Konda nurtures artistic expression through nature photography inspired by Ansel Adams, devouring historical mystery novels by Agatha Christie and Ann Cleeves, and attending performances by the Havre de Grace Community Theatre featuring classic Shakespearean productions, all of which feed their reflective yet inquisitive spirit.
info.travel_persona: Even Konda prefers short, well‑planned road trips to historic coastal towns like Williamsburg and nature retreats such as Assateague Island and Shenandoah Valley, balancing a modest travel budget with occasional international trips to Edinburgh to explore historic mystery tours, all while they manage their own itinerary with a blend of structure and last‑minute spontaneity.
info.culinary_persona: Even Konda delights in crafting seasonal, health‑focused meals from their garden, whipping up roasted beet‑quinoa salads with kale, chickpeas, and lemon‑tahini dressing, or simmering turmeric‑spiced lentil soup, reflecting both their culinary confidence and relentless quest for nutritious variety.
